note: WireGuard VPN (P4) — kazi ZOTE za mbali (discovery, OS install, apps, drivers, ripoti) zinaenda kupitia tunnel hii. Config hii ndiyo kanuni; env (FUNDI_WG_*) inaipa priority ikiwa ipo.

policy.note_sw: Bila VPN: remote work haianzi (policy). Discovery ya LAN ya ndani inaendelea kawaida.
policy.security: Keys ni Curve25519 halisi; server.key (0600) inahifadhiwa /data/wireguard; client confs zinapakuliwa kwa peer (hakuna private key kwenye server conf).
